bio.text: Julie Kushner was first elected to the Connecticut Senate on November 6, 2018, and represents the 24th Senate District, which includes Danbury and portions of New Fairfield and Ridgefield.
She was born in Hamburg, Iowa, grew up in Lincoln, Nebraska, graduated from the University of Wisconsin, and moved to Danbury from New York City in 1993.
She was elected Director of the United Auto Workers Region 9A and was co-chair of the Connecticut Working Families Party.
